decisions.reason: The two-component resin injection unit builds directly on the firm's core plural-component pumping and dosing know-how, so the firm can interpret field feedback and keep refining it.
As a sibling injection unit relying on the same in-house plural-component expertise, it fits the firm's knowledge base and serves construction sealing customers it already understands.
Automatic airless spray guns are a natural extension of the firm's long-established airless spray technology, where its absorptive capacity is strongest.
Manual airless guns are core accessories closely tied to the firm's existing pumps and service network, giving it ready knowledge to maintain and improve them.
The air-assisted airless gun line builds on established spray know-how and was consistently featured on its own page, indicating ongoing commitment.

The data logger draws on digital and electronics knowledge further from the firm's mechanical core, and its 2019 downgrade from its own page to a mention signals weaker emphasis, but it still complements the equipment and remains plausible to retain.
